why: Item 14 mixes first construction/placing with maintenance and repair, so the boundary between building progress and upkeep is easy to blur.

why.T3-048: The passages anticipate, react to, and reveal the separate 1RIT April Fools joke, an official joke by the organisation the sub follows, not a member-staged fake.

why.T3-010: Primary practice is negotiating space and borders between neighbouring works: fitting drawings, moving pixels, settling lines, and sharing spots.

why.T3-002: The item is a run of calls to the room's own members to come and place, build, repair, or concentrate on Undertale figures, not primarily an alarm about an attack already being fought.
The theme organises a logo effort by asking for help; the coordinate is attached to that call rather than the item being mainly a coordinate/template handout.

why.T3-009: The dominant passages celebrate the finished result with WE DID IT, while thanks and the end-of-place note are subordinate to that celebration.

why.T3-004: The passages work out which design/version and scale the room could make, including dropping the square, so the mark's look and size are being settled.

why.T3-070: The item circulates coordinates, templates, grid/reference images and how-to for placing the room's figures, which is the direction-sharing gate rather than event explanation.

why.T3-117: The single passage registers that r/place has stopped and calls the attempt a fun try, marking the canvas's end rather than mourning a specific lost work.

why.T3-054: After r/place stopped, the passages propose and push a smaller local place on the a-eskwadraat site, a later canvas answered by plans and encouragement.

why.T3-005: The passages answer visible or announced damage by protecting, defending, and repairing figures against attackers, with calls to hold the line.

why.T3-022: The leading practice is relocating, restarting, or redirecting the work after a loss: new Flowey versions, rebuilding the Bird, moving Asriel, and changing missions.
why.T3-181: A distinct set of concepts has members quitting or calling off the effort after damage or takeover, which T3-022 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-022 carries rebuilding, relocating, and redirecting after loss, but it does not reach the concepts where members quit or call off the effort altogether.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-181 is satisfied by C0335404 (giving up because people destroy too fast), C1272037 (calling off the symbol), and C0606824 (giving up on Mettaton after Overwatch took the spot).
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-181 if forced to one; then the item would lose the giving-up outcomes and carry only rebuilding/redirecting.

why.T3-001: Most concepts are the room's own staged April Fools fakes: fake Undertale 2 leaks, fake style/comic changes, and joke announcements played as true.
why.T3-095: A distinct set tests outside April Fools claims, especially whether Zombietale's disappearance or a hidden-link claim is really a joke.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-001 carries the room's own staged fakes and play-along/reveal, but it does not reach replies that test an outside claim as a possible April Fools joke.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-095 is satisfied by C0355014 and C1504308 (Zombietale disappearance checked as possible joke), C0061468 (got me), C1054058 (realizing the fan-series installment was a jape), and C1227360 (objecting the attack better be an April Fools joke).
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-095 if forced to one; then the item would carry only the staged jokes and lose the testing of outside claims.

why.T3-002: As at position 3, the item is a run of calls to the room's own members to come and place, build, repair, or concentrate on Undertale figures.

why.T3-021: The larger share is hands-on upkeep: repairing defaced figures, cleaning, maintaining Temmie, and fixing damage as it appears.
why.T3-038: A distinct set is first construction/placing: starting Flowey, finishing outlines, and laying the foundation pixels.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 carries watching, cleaning, and repairing existing figures, but it does not reach the first construction or placing progress where figures are started and outlines finished.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-038 is satisfied by C1510846 (starting Flowey from the bottom of the stem), C1106127 (finishing Temmie's outline), C0241770 (working on Frisk's head outline), and C0015127 (finished black eye pixels as foundation).
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-038 if forced to one; then the item would lose first construction/placing and carry only upkeep and repair.

why.T3-017: The exchange is ordinary side talk in the thread—guessing names and joking about stalking—with no canvas work or April Fools point, rather than a canvas in-joke.
